findings.claim: The new "no direct radix-ui imports" gate uses a `+` quantifier that is a literal character under grep's default BRE mode, so if `check_grep_empty` invokes plain `grep -r` (as its existing literal-string usages like "useGraphBridge" suggest), the pattern can never match and the gate is silently dead.
findings.evidence: Added hunk: `check_grep_empty "no direct radix-ui imports" "from[[:space:]]+['\"]radix-ui['\"]" "frontend/src/"`. BRE requires `\+` for one-or-more; unescaped `+` matches a literal '+', which never appears between `from` and the quote in real imports. The helper's implementation is not in the packet, and every pre-existing call site passes only literal strings, so nothing in the script demonstrates ERE mode. The same line-based pattern also misses a legal multi-line form where `from` ends one line and `"radix-ui"` begins the next.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the helper uses `grep -E`, or rewrite the pattern mode-agnostically as `from[[:space:]][[:space:]]*['"]radix-ui['"]`, and add a negative test (a fixture with a `radix-ui` import that must fail) the same way `test-flat2-style-negative.mjs` covers the Flat 2.0 gate.

findings.claim: The CI gates added for this change never scan `frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml` or the root `pnpm-lock.yaml`, so a future stale reintroduction of `@radix-ui/react-icons` into either lockfile (e.g., a bad merge or hand edit) would not trip any gate even though lockfile exclusion is a named acceptance criterion of this change.
findings.evidence: The new gates cover only `frontend/src/` (twice) and `frontend/package.json`: `check_grep_empty "no Radix icon dependency" "\"@radix-ui/react-icons\"[[:space:]]*:" "frontend/package.json"`. Acceptance criteria in the same diff state: "`frontend/package.json`, `frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml`, and the root `pnpm-lock.yaml` contain no `@radix-ui/react-icons` entry." A `--frozen-lockfile` install validates manifest/lockfile coherence but does not reject an orphaned or re-added package entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `check_grep_empty "no Radix icons in lockfiles" "@radix-ui/react-icons" "frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml"` and the equivalent for the root `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
